projects.formula_summary: per-object evaluator strain; Aim=VariableLengthStrainSkill geometric peak sum (decay 0.9), Speed/Reading=HarmonicSkill sorted per-object sum, Flashlight=StrainSkill; star ratings: aim=difficultyValue^0.63*0.02275, others=sqrt(difficultyValue)*0.0675; DifficultyToPerformance=4*d^3; total pp = Norm(1.1, aim, speed, accuracy, cognition)*1.12
projects.mods_handling: official mod transforms and clock rate
projects.known_limitations: tuned policy, not human skill truth; replay-free difficulty does not measure player ability

projects.formula_summary: aim strain = max(1.5*angle_bonus^0.99/max(107,prev_strain_time)+distance^0.99/max(107,strain_time), distance^0.99/strain_time); speed strain = (1+(speed_bonus-1)*0.75)*angle_bonus*(0.95+speed_bonus*(distance/125)^3.5)/max(delta_time,50); decay_base speed 0.3/s aim 0.15/s, strain scaling 1400/26.25; 400ms peak strains sorted descending, difficulty=sum(peak*0.9^i), stars=sqrt(difficulty)*scaling; separate sum(peak^1.2) feeds length bonus only
projects.known_limitations: single-file simplified ppv2; no slider accounting in old strain core

projects.formula_summary: older lazer generation: single AimEvaluator + SpeedEvaluator + RhythmEvaluator + FlashlightEvaluator; no Snap/Flow/Agility split and no Reading skill; pp = (aim^1.1+speed^1.1+acc^1.1+flashlight^1.1)^(1/1.1)*1.14
projects.known_limitations: not synchronized with ppy/osu 20260706 evaluator rework; no Reading/High-AR Reading skill; performance oracle, not skill taxonomy

projects.maintenance_status: low; last push 2026-07; public reading is a stub
projects.formula_summary: agility=distance/time strain with angle bonus; master precision=17.7635*(((agility+1)^0.28-0.995462)*CS)^1.06, human-time family GetPrecisionDecayFunc feeds agility v3 only; stamina=7000/(interval^(interval^0.045*0.8)) with 0.95 carryover; tenacity=longest stream interval/length; reaction=AR preempt pattern saturation; accuracy=42.2505*(stamina^2.5/SS_UR)^0.27; reading=0 stub
projects.mods_handling: DT/HT accuracy adjustment; EZ/HR/DT/HT AR/OD/CS transforms; HD/FL branches
projects.score_replay_involvement: none (beatmap + mods only despite 'Skill Points' output)
projects.known_limitations: no license; layer confusion (map demand labeled player skill); reading=0 stub; precision depends on agility; several TODOs (slider/SV/breaks)

projects.formula_summary: per top score: acc_val=pp_acc/1.1, aim_val=pp_aim/3.7, speed_val=pp_speed/2.5; weight=0.95^i; weighted means; skill=map(val)=-101*(8/(val/72+8))^10+101; archetypes from values within 91% of max
projects.mods_handling: score mods passed through rosu-pp performance calculator
projects.score_replay_involvement: score statistics only, no replay frames
projects.normalization: per-component nerf constants and monotone map squash to ~0..101
projects.known_limitations: inherits ppv2 component definitions (no stamina/reading axes); top-score sample bias; arbitrary nerf/map constants; no replay error signals

projects.formula_summary: tap score=1e6*sum(exp(-(tapDev/80)^2))/n; aim score=1e6*sum(exp(-(aimDev/30)^2))/n; reading diff=exp(dist-radius*sensitivity)-exp(-radius*sensitivity) from moving-average cursor model
projects.mods_handling: CS/AR/OD adjusted by mods for beatmap analyzers
projects.score_replay_involvement: replay frames required for deviation/scores; reading diff beatmap-only
projects.normalization: playfield pixels; Gaussian 1.0 at zero error; CS2px radius
projects.output_scale: cumulative 0..1e6-like scores; px/ms deviations; arbitrary reading units
projects.known_limitations: dormant; many stub analyzers; misses skipped in scores; heuristic reading model; no player-skill aggregation

projects.formula_summary: statsmodels OLS of hit error vs object coordinate for offset and width; OLS of player movement direction vs object direction for rotation; significance via p-values and Cook's distance
projects.mods_handling: no mod normalization beyond AR/CS filtering
projects.output_scale: regression parameters (px, multiplier, degrees) with confidence
projects.confidence_uncertainty: statistical only (OLS intervals, p-values, Cook's distance)
projects.known_limitations: only spaced circles; excludes streams/sliders; single-technique diagnostic; no map-demand or player-skill aggregation

projects.mods_handling: rate/difficulty edits written into a new .osu; oppai preview
